name: kg-declared-model
description: Build a Knowledge Graph deterministically from a model that stores its metadata WITH itself as an ISO/IEC 11179 metadata registry (object_class / data_element / value_domain / permissible_value / association). Entities, attributes with meanings and PII classes, decoded value codes, declared joins, is_a supertypes and cross-domain type correspondences are walked directly into the two-layer topology; the deployed types come from the data dictionary. No LLM, no MCP, zero tokens, re-syncable.
author: TDA Core Team

auto_generate.description: Deterministic, zero-token construction: connect to a database connection, discover which ISO/IEC 11179 registries are deployed there, read the chosen registry plus the data dictionary, and walk it into entities and relationships. Reproducible, free, and re-syncable when the registry changes.

connection_id.description: Database connection holding the registry and the model it describes. Credentials are resolved through the platform's encrypted connection store.

catalog_database.description: The database holding the five ISO/IEC 11179 registry tables, discovered from the selected connection.

core_database.description: The database the model's entities deploy into (the graph's anchor and the grounding gate's trusted scope). Empty = read from the registry's own deployed_object column.

model_name.description: Display name of the logical model root (e.g. Policing Core). Every entity is qualified by it.

discovery_mode.description: Strategy selector — fixed for this template.

include_columns.description: Include attribute and column nodes carrying each data element's definition, PII/sensitivity classification, declared vs deployed type and decoded permissible values. Off = a compact entity-level graph.

include_physical.description: Include the physical layer (schema/table/column) with real queryable identifiers and types read from the data dictionary — views included. Required for the grounding gate's trusted scope.

max_value_codes.description: Cap on decoded permissible values kept per attribute, bounding node payloads on large code lists.

validate_with_source.description: Probe the deployed objects for row counts, declared-key uniqueness, stored date shapes and blank ratios, and stamp them on the graph.

manual.description: Knowledge graphs are populated via the constructor.

document_upload.description: Knowledge graphs are populated from the deployed registry, not documents.

logical_entities.description: Logical layer — the model's meaning, from the registry

physical_entities.description: Physical layer — the deployed, queryable realization (tables AND views)
